opennyai_summary.16_June_2023__facts:
Out of the wedlock, a female child was born.
After the marriage, the appellant was harassing the deceased by demanding dowry taking her caste name and insulting her and the deceased was also Nagaraja Reddy vs The State Of Karnataka
After that the complainant went to a hotel to bring food for the deceased Lakshmi and at about 4.30 p.m. when she returned, the deceased Lakshmi committed suicide by hanging herself behind the house of the appellant.
Immediately thereafter she was shifted to hospital but declared dead.
Initially, a complaint came to be registered for the offence punishable under Section 302 of IPC.
During investigation it was found that the deceased was committed suicide by leaving a death note.
Hence, charge sheet came to be filed for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 304B, 114 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3(1)(r), 1(s), 3(2)(v) of the Schedule Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Amendment Act 1961 and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act against the other accused also arraying the appellant as accused No.1.
The appellant has filed a bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail before the Special Court, which came to be dismissed.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The death note reveals that on the advise of the family members, the appellant used to come to the house in a drunken stage and assaulted the deceased physically, which also abetted the deceased to commit suicide.
Even after the marriage the appellant was harassing the deceased by NC: 2023:KHC:20772 taking her caste name, which also attracts Section 3(1)(r), (1)(s) and 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (POA) Act and also harassing the deceased by demanding dowry which attracts Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Merely the appellant is in judicial custody.
There is no ground to allow the appeal and grant bail to the appellant as he has committed serious offences.
If he is released on bail, there is likelihood of the appellant tampering the prosecution witness and absconding from the case is not ruled out and it will give a wrong message to the society.
opennyai_summary.16_June_2023__decision:
Therefore, the trial Court has rightly rejected the petition and bail application.
Hence, it does not call for interference.
The appeal is dismissed.
